page.overview:
Who is Dajimu?

Dajimu, like most members of the group, was likely trained to lose emotions in order to better accomplish missions. As Root members each use a codename, it is unknown what Dajimu's real name is, if he even has one.

Even though the organisation has been officially disbanded, Dajimu remains loyal to its head, Danzō Shimura.

Dajimu and Tera had both been secretly assigned by Danzō to assassinate Anko Mitarashi, but due to the village's situation at that time, their mission was postponed in preference of finding Kabuto Yakushi before she did.
